title: Lost Mary Maryliq x Crystal Strawberry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Maryliq x Crystal Strawberry Ice by Lost Mary takes a timeless summer flavour and elevates it with a high-definition recipe. Part of the refined Crystal series, this blend focuses on the authentic, sugary sweetness of garden-fresh strawberries. The inhale is packed with juicy red fruit notes, while the exhale introduces a clean, icy finish that refreshes the palate. It is a vibrant and crisp profile that offers a satisfying depth of flavour. Featuring a standard 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this nic salt e-liquid is engineered for consistency and clarity in low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) kits. The 20mg nicotine salt formulation ensures a gentle throat hit, making it easy to enjoy the intense strawberry flavour without harshness. This is a perfect option for vapers looking for a premium, fruit-forward vape with a cooling kick.
